---
name: Missing feature
about: a role, state, pattern, interface, event or text query broa11y does not expose
labels: enhancement
---

**What you need:** the role, state, AT-SPI interface, UIA pattern,
NSAccessibility attribute, event or text unit you are missing.

**How the platforms do it:** if GTK, Qt, Chromium or the platform's own
documentation already expose this, how (the interface, pattern or attribute,
and which screen reader uses it).

**What you are building:** what you need it for. A real application is the
most useful answer; it is what decides which gaps get closed first.
